blocks.text: Yeh Unit 9 (Division of Polynomials) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Divide \(2x^{4} - 3x^{3} + x^{2} + 5x - 4\) by \(x^{2} - x + 2\). Find the quotient and remainder and verify the result. (5 marks)
(\(2x^{4} - 3x^{3} + x^{2} + 5x - 4\) ko \(x^{2} - x + 2\) se taqseem karein. Quotient aur remainder nikal kar tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Leading term ko leading term se taqseem, wapas zarb, minus, aur dohrayein jab tak remainder ki degree 2 se kam na ho.

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

steps: Remainder ki degree 1 < 2, ruk jayein: quotient \(2x^{2} - x - 4\)
Tasdeeq: \((x^{2} - x + 2)(2x^{2} - x - 4) + 3x + 4\) dividend deta hai

blocks.prompt:
2 Divide \(x^{4} + 2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + x - 1\) by \(x + 3\) by long division, and check the remainder by the remainder theorem. (5 marks)
(\(x^{4} + 2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + x - 1\) ko \(x + 3\) se long division se taqseem karein aur remainder theorem se remainder ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Qadam ba qadam long division; remainder \(f(-3)\) ke barabar hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: This unit studies the division of one polynomial by another to find the quotient and the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
3 State and prove the remainder theorem. Use it to find the remainder when \(3x^{4} - 2x^{2} + x - 7\) is divided by \(x - 2\). (5 marks)
(Remainder theorem bayan aur saabit karein. Is se \(3x^{4} - 2x^{2} + x - 7\) ko \(x - 2\) se taqseem karne ka remainder nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Division identity \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x) + R\) likh kar \(x = a\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

steps: Bayan: \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se taqseem karne par remainder \(f(a)\) hai

blocks.prompt:
4 The polynomial \(x^{3} + ax^{2} + bx + 6\) leaves remainder 2 when divided by \(x - 1\) and remainder 6 when divided by \(x + 1\). Find \(a\) and \(b\). (5 marks)
(Polynomial \(x^{3} + ax^{2} + bx + 6\) ko \(x - 1\) se taqseem karne par remainder 2 aur \(x + 1\) se taqseem karne par remainder 6 hai. \(a\) aur \(b\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har remainder se remainder theorem ke zariye aik equation; dono hal karein.

book_ref.quote: till no \(x\)-term exists in the remainder, then \(f(a)\) is the remainder.

blocks.prompt:
5 State and prove the factor theorem. Use it to show that \(x - 2\) and \(x + 3\) are factors of \(x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 5x - 6\), and find the third factor. (5 marks)
(Factor theorem bayan aur saabit karein. Is se dikhayein ke \(x - 2\) aur \(x + 3\), \(x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 5x - 6\) ke factors hain, aur teesra factor nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Remainder theorem (R = f(a)) dono taraf lagayein; phir do factors ke hasil-e-zarb se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

steps: Bayan: \(x - a\) factor hai agar aur sirf agar \(f(a) = 0\)

blocks.prompt:
6 If \(x - 1\) and \(x - 3\) are factors of \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 3\), find \(p\) and \(q\) and factorize the polynomial completely. (5 marks)
(Agar \(x - 1\) aur \(x - 3\), \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 3\) ke factors hon to \(p\), \(q\) nikalein aur polynomial ko poori tarah factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(1) = 0\), \(f(3) = 0\) rakh kar hal karein, phir maloom factors se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
7 If \(-1\) and \(3\) are roots of \(x^{3} + ax^{2} + bx + 3 = 0\), find \(a\) and \(b\), and find the third root. (5 marks)
(Agar \(-1\) aur \(3\), \(x^{3} + ax^{2} + bx + 3 = 0\) ke roots hon to \(a\), \(b\) aur teesra root nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Root a ka matlab \(f(a) = 0\), yani x - a factor; do roots se do equations.

book_ref.quote: is the root of the polynomial equation

blocks.prompt:
8 Find \(k\) if \(x - 2\) is a factor of \(x^{3} + kx^{2} - 4x + 12\). Then factorize the polynomial completely using synthetic division. (5 marks)
(\(k\) nikalein agar \(x - 2\), \(x^{3} + kx^{2} - 4x + 12\) ka factor ho. Phir synthetic division se poori tarah factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: Factor theorem se k; \(x - 2\) se synthetic division se quadratic quotient.

book_ref.quote: is a factor of the polynomial \(f(x)\) iff \(f(a) = 0\).

blocks.prompt:
9 If \(x - 1\) and \(x + 2\) are factors of \(x^{4} - 5x^{2} + 4\), use synthetic division to find the other two factors. (5 marks)
(Agar \(x - 1\) aur \(x + 2\), \(x^{4} - 5x^{2} + 4\) ke factors hon to synthetic division se baqi do factors nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(x - 1\) se synthetic division, phir quotient ko \(x + 2\) se; baqi quadratic factorize karein.

blocks.prompt:
10 Use synthetic division to show that \(x = 2\) and \(x = -1\) are zeros of \(2x^{4} - x^{3} - 8x^{2} + x + 6\), and factorize it completely. (5 marks)
(Synthetic division se dikhayein ke \(x = 2\) aur \(x = -1\), \(2x^{4} - x^{3} - 8x^{2} + x + 6\) ke zeros hain, aur isay poori tarah factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: Synthetic division mein remainder zero ho to zero hai; do baar taqseem kar ke quadratic factorize karein.

book_ref.quote: Use the following patterns to write the second and third lines:

blocks.prompt:
11 Use synthetic division to find the quotient and remainder when \(3x^{4} - 2x^{3} + 5x - 7\) is divided by \(x + 2\). Verify the remainder by the remainder theorem. (5 marks)
(Synthetic division se \(3x^{4} - 2x^{3} + 5x - 7\) ko \(x + 2\) se taqseem karne par quotient aur remainder nikalein. Remainder theorem se tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Missing x² ke liye 0 likh kar tamam coefficients aur a = -2 lein.

blocks.prompt:
12 If \(x - 2\) and \(x + 1\) are factors of \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 4\), use synthetic division to find \(p\) and \(q\), and factorize the polynomial. (5 marks)
(Agar \(x - 2\) aur \(x + 1\), \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx - 4\) ke factors hon to synthetic division se \(p\), \(q\) nikalein aur polynomial factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har factor ke liye teesri line ka aakhri number (remainder) zero hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
13 A regression model \(P(x) = 2x^{3} - x^{2} + 3x + 1\) is fitted to monthly sales data. The observed sales in the 4th month are 130 units. Using synthetic division (remainder theorem) find the predicted sales, the error and the percentage error. (5 marks)
(Mahana sales data par regression model \(P(x) = 2x^{3} - x^{2} + 3x + 1\) fit hai. 4th mahine ki observed sales 130 units hain. Synthetic division (remainder theorem) se predicted sales, error aur percentage error nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Predicted P(4) = x - 4 se taqseem ka remainder; Error = Observed - Predicted; percentage = |Error/Observed| × 100.

blocks.prompt:
14 A system is represented by \(P(z) = z^{4} + 2z^{3} - z^{2} - 2z\). Show that the system response is zero at \(z = 1\) and \(z = -2\), and factorize \(P(z)\) completely. (5 marks)
(System \(P(z) = z^{4} + 2z^{3} - z^{2} - 2z\) se zahir hai. Dikhayein ke \(z = 1\) aur \(z = -2\) par response zero hai, aur \(P(z)\) ko poori tarah factorize karein.)
blocks.explanation: Zero response se factors z - 1 aur z + 2; synthetic division se unhein nikalein.

book_ref.quote: If the remainder is zero, it means that the system has no error at that input.
